title: College football
notes: Replayed on 2024-25, 1,624 games: picked the winner 71% of the time, the closing line 73%. The market was the better forecast.
Replayed on 2024-25: right against the closing spread 51% of the time. No edge on the line, and late in the season the model runs closest to the market (0.2 points behind from week 10).
Priced from the same margin as the spread; alternate lines were not replayed on their own.
Replayed on 2024-25: on the right side of the closing total 53% of the time - 53.4% and 52.7% in the two seasons. Above break-even in both, but within the noise of 1,624 games.
Priced from the same total as the over/under; alternate lines were not replayed on their own.

Careful: the model rates NCSU 6 points better than DraftKings does. Replayed on 2024-25, gaps this size went the market's way: the model's side won about 49% of 397 such games, and at 10+ apart its margin was 16.5 points out against the market's 10.4. More likely something the model cannot see than an edge.
